# `world/ZoneManager.js`

> **Source:** `engine/world/ZoneManager.js`

ZoneManager.js - World Zone Management System Manages different zone types for gameplay: - Saved zones: Persistent destruction that saves with the world - Battle zones: Temporary destruction that resets on exit - Safe zones: No destruction allowed Also handles: - Zone boundary particle containment - Cross-zone material transfer - Zone transitions and effects

## Classes

Represents a single zone in the world

| `distanceToBoundary` | `distanceToBoundary(point)` | Get distance to zone boundary (negative = inside) |
| `clampPoint` | `clampPoint(point)` | Clamp a point to stay inside the zone |
| `recordVoxelChange` | `recordVoxelChange(x, y, z, originalMaterial, newMaterial)` | Record voxel modification for potential reset |
| `getModifications` | `getModifications()` | Get all voxel modifications |
| `clearModifications` | `clearModifications()` | Clear modification tracking |

## Notes & Examples

### World Streaming & Scenes

The world system manages scene graphs, asset streaming, and level transitions. Scenes are entity hierarchies with spatial indexing (BVH) for fast culling and raycasts. Worlds stream assets asynchronously with priority based on distance and visibility.

**Example: Scene graph and streaming**
```js
import { World } from 'engine/world/World.js';
import { Scene } from 'engine/scenes/Scene.js';
import { Entity } from 'engine/ecs/Entity.js';

const world = new World();
const scene = new Scene();
world.addScene(scene);

// Create hierarchy
const player = new Entity('Player');
const camera = new Entity('Camera');
const weapon = new Entity('Weapon');

player.addChild(camera);
camera.addChild(weapon);  // Weapon follows camera

scene.add(player);

// Stream in a level
await world.streamLevel('level1', {
  priority: 'high',
  bounds: player.boundingBox,
  onProgress: (pct) => console.log(`Loading: ${pct}%`)
});

// Spatial query: find entities in radius
const nearby = scene.querySphere(player.position, 50);
```
